author: marici.Strominger

checks.statement: the symbolic reconstruction numerator is the adjugate
a complement to M is faithful exactly off gamma+delta=0
the source-authorized E,M pair has determinant -2
E is nonzero on the magnetic blind direction
M is nonzero on the electric blind direction
a proportional second port leaves the blind line intact

verdict: Two scalar sheet ports reconstruct exactly when their Plucker determinant is nonzero. A complement to M=(1,-1) is sufficient iff gamma+delta is nonzero. Reflection authority canonically selects E=(1,1), and each parity port is injective on the other port's kernel.
